title: ProtocolRecord
description: Schema root for the versioned participant protocol and allocation views.

AuthorityDomains.description:
Persistent identities outside resettable job history. The machine resource
scope and its native execution child are different domains.

AuthorityHold.description: A durable whole-authority admission hold. Process exit does not release it.

AuthoritySnapshot.description: Bootstrap/maintenance interlock, separate from resettable Job history.

AuthorityStorageBudget.description: Durable metadata capacity, separate from machine resource claims.

BootstrapProof.description: Sealed Linux leaf evidence; only the trusted bridge may attest this record.

BootstrapWork.description: Transitional MR-0 Linux work descriptor, executed only by the installed bridge.

delegate_test_cgroup.description:
Test-only nested delegation, contained by the outer bootstrap obligation.
The supervisor supplies STILLYARD_TEST_CGROUP_ROOT; no host subtree is writable.

oneOf.description: Retain the full debit while local containment/lifetime proof is unknown.
Enumerate every outstanding allocation in bounded pages.
The manager has durably applied every reply through this sequence.

ConnectChallenge.description:
Every identity, nonce and version participates in the authentication tag.
The receiving coordinator must also match its pending, single-use challenge.

EventPage.description:
Events are bounded observations, never cleanup or authority proofs. A gap
requires refreshing allocation/accounting snapshots before applying deltas.

queue_accepted_unix_millis.description: Original coordinator queue identity/time, retained independently of SQL.

boundary_sha256.description: Digest of the manager's durable platform boundary/root identity record.

ManagedParent.description: Server-authenticated identity of the primary Invocation that submitted child work.

NativeAllocationSnapshot.description:
Allocation/Lease association. The historical Rust type name is retained.
Native admission shares the Grant and Lease UUID; an attached allocation
reports its actual coordinator Grant ID and separately bound local Lease ID.
This observation introduces no second resource counter.

key.description: Absent when authority identity/history cannot be established.

NativeStartPermission.description:
Reset-independent coverage of a born-contained native root before it can
execute user code. Native SQL and this record describe the same allocation.

SealedRelease.description:
This is a domain-scoped manager attestation, accepted only from its paired
executor. The platform manager must seal all start rights before sending it.
